summary:
Rosalie Hale was always fascinated by electricity and mechanics and physics. But pretty girls in the 1930s don't worry their little heads over such complicated things. A girl like her is better served marrying a nice young man, isn't she?
(She really isn't. She is still fascinated by light bulbs and automobiles and rocket science. She finally marries, but she still wants to study physics.)
